name: Kitakata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kitakata city emblem in green and red: a green stylised plant with red berries.
history: Municipal flag of Kitakata, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 12 July 2006; the emblem dates from 4 July 2006.

features.role: Kitakata city emblem — a green stylised plant with red berries
